thread:
erin: FYI BetaSolutions says their Feb invoice includes ~350k embed tokens that were actually client-side retries. They sent logs and are asking for a correction. Ticket REF-768.
 tom: I pulled the support thread. Customer points to a ~2026-02-20 14:22 UTC spike where their client retried on 429s but our dedup layer didn't collapse retries for embeddings.
 rachel: That's concerning. We have dedup based on request_id for text-gen but embedding calls used a different id path until the 2026-02-19 patch. If they retried using new request ids, we may have double-counted.
 erin: Can you quantify how many tokens are affected? They claim 350k. We need a validated number to decide on credit and GL posting.
 rachel: Running a quick aggregation against usage_events for tenant beta-sol with window 2026-02-20T14:00Z..2026-02-20T14:40Z.

 metering-bot: Query summary: tenant=beta-sol window=2026-02-20T14:00..14:40 total_embed_tokens=1,120,412 suspect_duplicate_groups=1,418 implied_duplicate_tokens=327,400

 rachel: The bot matches their approximate number. Suspect duplicate groups are requests that share client-side request_key but different server request_id and final_status=200 in more than one attempt.
 tom: They also attached client logs showing exponential backoff and three attempts for many calls. Example snippet:
 ```
 client: req_key=abc123 attempt=1 status=429
 client: req_key=abc123 attempt=2 status=200
 ```

 erin: Policy question: do we bill for repeated successful attempts if the client retried? Historically we bill compute used; but for dedupable embedding work we made exceptions when it's clear the same logical request re-executed due to retries.
 rachel: Right. Our current billing enforcement after the 2026-02-19 change dedups by client_request_key and marks duplicates nonbillable. But calls before the deploy were out of luck. We can run a targeted backfill to flip the duplicate rows for that tenant/time-window.

 erin: What would the financial impact and risk be? Also need estimate for engineering effort.
 rachel: Estimate: flipping 327,400 embed tokens -> at embed rate that's ~$98.22. Engineering: one engineer ~4 hours to run and validate; small risk to dashboards; we'll coordinate a temporary alert suppression. I can produce a reconciled CSV and a short memo within the day.
 tom: Customer asked for immediate goodwill. Can Finance issue a provisional credit for up to $150 while we validate? They want the invoice adjusted quickly.
 erin: I can approve a provisional credit of $120 pending the reconciled CSV. GL code: 4-210-ADJ. If the final validated credit differs, we'll reconcile on the next invoice.
 metering-bot: Action logged: provisional-credit-1801010101 amount=120 currency=USD requester=erin state=issued
 rachel: I'll kick off the backfill script with dry-run and post the reconciled CSV in REF-768. I'll also tag the deploy change so we don't repeat this.
 erin: Thanks. Tom, please update the support ticket with the provisional credit and expected completion ETA 48h.
 tom: Done. I'll cc billing for the memo.
